mutations.name: the-default-goes-back-to-a-cwd-relative-path
mutations._mechanism: The original defect. Same state and same files give BLOCKED from the monorepo root and READY from the sub-project -- and in a tree that happens to hold a matching relative path, READY on another feature's analysis with nothing in the output naming the file it read.

mutations.name: the-docs-root-fallback-goes-back-to-a-bare-relative-docs
mutations._mechanism: The half-fix that looks complete. Anchoring only the `state is inside docs/` branch leaves every other layout resolving against the CWD, and that branch is the one nobody tests because HemaSuite happens to keep state in docs/. Shared with telemetry, so the same silent mis-rooting reaches cycle-count derivation too.

mutations.name: an-explicit-analysis-path-gets-re-rooted
mutations._mechanism: The over-correction, and it is silent in the opposite direction: a path the operator typed is quietly moved under the state file's docs tree, so `--analysis mine.md` reads a file they did not name and did not write. Anchoring the DEFAULT must not touch an explicit argument.
mutations.find:
if explicit is not None:
        return explicit

mutations.name: the-state-in-docs-branch-is-skipped
mutations._mechanism: Without it a state file at `<proj>/docs/.bkit-memory.json` resolves to `<proj>/docs/docs/03-analysis`, which does not exist -- a false BLOCKED on every project laid out the normal way. Loud, but it would be attributed to a missing analysis rather than to the resolver.

mutations.name: ignore-the-docs-root-flag
mutations._mechanism: The flag parses and changes nothing: every check reads main's docs, the #101 BLOCKED returns.
mutations.find: docs_root = (args.docs_root if args.docs_root is not None  # M:P7-DOCS-ROOT

mutations.name: leave-the-default-analysis-on-main
mutations._mechanism: The checks move to the worktree but the default analysis stays on main's docs, so two trees are read as one.
mutations.find: root = docs_root if docs_root is not None else resolve_docs_root(None, state_path)

mutations.name: keep-the-checks-on-the-state-files-docs
mutations._mechanism: The analysis follows the flag but the versioned and parked-spec checks still read main's docs.

mutations.name: accept-a-docs-root-that-does-not-exist
mutations._mechanism: A typo reads as 'no analysis here': a verdict about artifacts the gate never looked at.
mutations.find: if args.docs_root is not None and not args.docs_root.is_dir():  # M:P7-DOCS-ROOT-EXISTS
